highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 updates platform integrations and corrects native and managed reliability issues.
highlights_body: The unreleased line refreshes the bundled Skia engine, modernizes its supported platform toolchains, and reduces allocations in image and text processing.

bullets.detail: Brings the latest upstream Chrome m156 bug fixes into the native renderer used by SkiaSharp applications.

bullets.lead: String conversion and validation made safe
bullets.detail: Corrects Unicode validation and prevents native buffer over-reads when creating strings and SKData from C strings.
Uses ABI-compatible Boolean and HarfBuzz Boolean representations for managed callback delegates.

bullets.lead: Android texture updates synchronized with display refresh
bullets.detail: Improves the timing of Android texture rendering to avoid visible presentation problems.
Corrects retention behavior for front-buffered streams so their backing resources remain available when needed.
Optimizes managed image pixel copying to reduce overhead when transferring pixel data.
Avoids unnecessary native feature-string allocations and pools UTF-32 encoding buffers used during HarfBuzz text processing.

bullets.lead: Uno WinUI support updated for Uno Platform 7
bullets.detail: Builds SkiaSharp.Views.Uno.WinUI against Uno Platform 7 for compatibility with the current Uno release.

bullets.lead: Apple and Windows native support modernized
bullets.detail: Raises Apple deployment minimums and aligns Windows native dependencies with supported MAUI releases and the current Windows toolchain.

bullets.lead: Browser and Linux native assets made more self-contained
bullets.detail: Ships the WebGPU implementation in the static native library and resolves bundled HarfBuzz functions locally on Linux.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Bundled the WebGPU implementation with the native library and updated Uno WinUI support for Uno Platform 7
contributor_summaries.VirgilMing: Bound bundled HarfBuzz functions locally on Linux and improved Blazor CPU sample test readiness
contributor_summaries.dalexsoto: Addressed contextual PoliCheck findings in the build configuration
